item.title: mlx audio swift
item.description:
## The Problem
Running modern speech models (TTS, STT, audio codecs) on Apple Silicon usually means bridging Python MLX code into a Swift app or shelling out to a server. This repo is a native Swift SDK that runs those models directly on-device via MLX, so a macOS/iOS app can do text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and audio tokenization without leaving the process.

item.title: bbtree
item.description:
## The Problem Applications that rely on an ordered key/value store often use the standard library’s `BTreeMap`. At high concurrency it becomes a bottleneck: insertions and lookups contend on a single lock, and the map’s memory layout leads to cache misses. Developers need a low‑latency, high‑throughput ordered map that can be dropped in without adding external dependencies.
